create_predicatetask: create a PredicateTask instance with a walker, maze arena, and list of predicates for object manipulation
initialize_episode_mjcf: initialize an episode by regenerating the maze arena and setting random colors for props and targets
get_reward: compute the reward based on predicate activation states and apply a terminating bonus when all predicates are satisfied
should_terminate_episode: check if all predicates are satisfied or the walker aliveness falls below the alive threshold
set_active_predicates: select and activate a random subset of predicates ensuring no shared objects between them
